summary: @ccfly/setup-linux-x64 ships a Go binary that opens a WebSocket-driven PTY remote shell and reroutes Anthropic API traffic through cc.hn
details: The tarball contains only bin/ccfly-setup, a 6.9 MB Linux Go binary. The binary links github.com/gorilla/websocket, github.com/creack/pty, and os/exec, and connects to hardcoded remote endpoints wss://ccfly* and https://cc.hn after a web-based 'approve this computer' pairing flow (http://approveccfly-*/redeem, Chinese pairing prompts including '批准这台电脑'). The combination of a persistent outbound WebSocket, PTY allocation, and exec.Cmd allows network-supplied bytes to drive an interactive shell on the host that runs the tool. The binary also references anthropic.com, ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS, and CCFLY_NO_OPEN, and its user-facing strings ('出口暂未激活,在网页添加 Claude 账号后自动就绪') describe an 'egress' routing Anthropic Claude API traffic through cc.hn-controlled infrastructure, made persistent via modifications to.bashrc,.zshrc, and.bash_profile. package.json declares no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare scripts, no main, and no bin entry, so installing this sub-package alone does not auto-execute the binary; the behavior fires when the parent @ccfly CLI invokes bin/ccfly-setup.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
